title: Lab 1C — WAF on CloudFront
topic: WAF Web ACL scope CLOUDFRONT vs REGIONAL, managed rule groups, Shield Standard, Firewall Manager, SQLi blocking on api/wiki*, cost teardown
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces Night 4 saa-study-globalskiatlas-waf lab on globalskiatlas.com. Answer without night-4-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×2 B×3 C×2 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Night 4 lab attached Web ACL saa-study-globalskiatlas-waf to CloudFront distribution E3BDMTLYF8G4VB for globalskiatlas.com. In which Region must you create a CLOUDFRONT-scoped Web ACL?

options.A: Any Region where the S3 bucket resides
options.B: us-east-1 (N. Virginia) only for WAF resources used with CloudFront
options.C: eu-west-1 to match the closest viewers in Europe
options.D: The same Region as the API Gateway REST API backing /api/wiki*

questions.question: You later add an Application Load Balancer in us-east-1 for a new API. Which WAF scope applies to that ALB?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT — all WAF ACLs are global regardless of resource
options.B: REGIONAL — created in the same Region as the ALB or API Gateway Regional resource
options.C: GLOBAL — Shield Advanced scope replaces WAF for ALBs
options.D: EDGE — only CloudFront Functions can attach WAF to ALBs

questions.question: Night 4 managed rules included AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet, KnownBadInputs, and SQLiRuleSet. A legitimate wiki POST to /api/wiki/pages returns 403 after attach. What is the first troubleshooting step?

options.A: Delete the Cognito user pool so all requests become anonymous GET
options.B: Inspect WAF sampled requests / CloudWatch metrics to see which rule blocked the request
options.C: Disable TLS on CloudFront so WAF can inspect plaintext bodies
options.D: Move DynamoDB tables to Aurora so SQLi rules no longer apply

questions.question: Which AWS service provides free automatic protection against common network and transport layer DDoS on CloudFront?

options.A: AWS WAF SQLi managed rule group only
options.B: AWS Shield Standard (included at no extra charge for CloudFront and Route 53)
options.C: AWS Network Firewall on the VPC subnet

questions.question: You need stateful inspection and filtering of east-west traffic between subnets inside a VPC (not HTTP at CloudFront). Which service fits?

options.A: AWS WAF Web ACL with CLOUDFRONT scope
options.B: AWS Network Firewall deployed in VPC subnets
options.C: Security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports

questions.question: Night 4 lab: GET wiki pages and POST with valid Cognito JWT should pass; a curl probe with SQL injection in the body should be blocked. Which layer enforces the SQLi block?

options.A: S3 bucket policy Deny on suspicious object keys
options.B: AWS WAF inspecting HTTP request at CloudFront before origin forward
options.C: DynamoDB condition expression on WikiPages partition key

questions.question: After the lab, the Web ACL was detached and deleted to avoid ongoing cost (~$96/yr). What still protects globalskiatlas.com at L3/L4?

options.A: Nothing — CloudFront is fully public without any AWS DDoS mitigation
options.B: AWS Shield Standard on CloudFront distribution automatically
options.C: WAF continues blocking SQLi even after Web ACL deletion via cache
options.D: API Gateway resource policy replaces all edge security

questions.question: A company with 50 AWS accounts wants one central team to deploy the same WAF managed rule groups to all CloudFront distributions. Which service?

options.A: AWS Firewall Manager with WAF policies
options.B: IAM Access Analyzer external access findings
options.C: AWS Config aggregator for CloudFront distributions
options.D: Replace WAF with security group rules on the S3 bucket

questions.question: Rate-based rules in AWS WAF are commonly used to mitigate which threat on a public wiki API?

options.A: Brute-force or abusive HTTP request floods from a single IP
options.B: Cross-Region Aurora failover during AZ outage
options.C: KMS key rotation scheduled every 365 days

questions.question: Night 4 vs Night 8 callback: WAF on an internal ALB in a VPC serving HTTPS from clients in the same Region uses which scope and attachment point?

options.A: CLOUDFRONT scope attached in us-east-1 to the ALB listener ARN
options.B: REGIONAL scope Web ACL associated directly with the ALB or API Gateway Regional
options.C: GLOBAL scope on Route 53 hosted zone only — ALBs cannot use WAF
options.D: EDGE scope via Lambda@Edge on S3 origin only
